timeline.text: Dictate a recurring event for a semester, and the assistant used to spell out every date itself.
Six months of Tuesdays was so much text the reply broke, leaving a bare processing error.
Like writing every Tuesday on a calendar by hand, instead of saying 'repeat weekly.'
Now it just says what repeats, and the server fills in each date — the JSON never breaks.
The series is capped at two hundred events, so one bad dictation can't run away forever.
